findings.fact: GNU flags are unconditional and install rules only name LIBRARY, omitting Windows RUNTIME DLL and ARCHIVE import-library destinations.
findings.claim_boundary: No target build was run; compiler incompatibility is a source-visible risk.

findings.fact: Full-engine staging rejects Apple/Windows and enforces ELF sonames, readelf, and $ORIGIN.

Non-Unix stdin streaming and timed pipe reads are refused; named-file use is unaffected.
